title: Join Redwire at AUSA 2026
summary: At AUSA 2026, Redwire will showcase its combat-proven Stalker Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), one-of-a-kind Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) technology, and portfolio of Octopus payloads as we support…
body_markdown:
At **[AUSA 2026](https://meetings.ausa.org/annual/2026/index.cfm)** , Redwire will showcase its combat-proven


**Stalker Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS)** ,


one-of-a-kind


**Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC)** technology, and portfolio of


**Octopus payloads** as we support


**“America’s Army: The Foundation of the Joint Force.”**


Redwire is proud to support U.S. Army operations and training initiatives across multiple Programs of Record and customers, including the


[U.S. Army Aviation Center of Excellence (USAACE)](https://mcas-proxyweb.mcas-gov.us/certificate-checker?login=false&originalUrl=https%3A%2F%2Frdw.com.mcas-gov.us%2Fnewsroom%2Fredwire-accelerates-mission-readiness-with-tailored-uas-trainings-for-u-s-army-aviation-center-of-excellence-and-ukrainian-armed-forces%2F%3FMcasTsid%3D20892&McasCSRF=be04e3610b11adfd74e3215aa91720994ccce749f992d4e068871f86fe7f0f48) **/1st Aviation Brigade,**[4 th Infantry Division](https://mcas-proxyweb.mcas-gov.us/certificate-checker?login=false&originalUrl=https%3A%2F%2Frdw.com.mcas-gov.us%2Fnewsroom%2Fredwire-supports-u-s-army-modernization-demonstrating-key-integration-of-the-stalker-uas-at-ivy-sting-iv%2F%3FMcasTsid%3D20892&McasCSRF=be04e3610b11adfd74e3215aa91720994ccce749f992d4e068871f86fe7f0f48) **, 25** **th** **Infantry Division** , and


[Army National Guard](https://mcas-proxyweb.mcas-gov.us/certificate-checker?login=false&originalUrl=https%3A%2F%2Frdw.com.mcas-gov.us%2Fnewsroom%2Fstalker-uas-supports-national-guard-modernization-and-mission-readiness-with-long-endurance-capabilities%2F%3FMcasTsid%3D20892&McasCSRF=be04e3610b11adfd74e3215aa91720994ccce749f992d4e068871f86fe7f0f48) .


On the second day of AUSA 2026, **October 13** , Redwire will host a


**“You Control the Mission!”** interactive where guests who visit booth #2125 can operate the Octopus 140 payload flying on a Stalker UAS in real time. Don’t miss this


target treasure hunt for exclusive prizes!


Guests who stop by


**#2125** **on Tuesday between 9:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.** will also receive a complimentary espresso drink from the booth coffee bar


and can learn about


**Redwire’s official drone partnership with the**[Washington Commanders](https://mcas-proxyweb.mcas-gov.us/certificate-checker?login=false&originalUrl=https%3A%2F%2Frdw.com.mcas-gov.us%2Fnewsroom%2Fredwire-becomes-proud-drone-technology-partner-of-the-washington-commanders-to-showcase-military-appreciation%2F%3FMcasTsid%3D20892&McasCSRF=be04e3610b11adfd74e3215aa91720994ccce749f992d4e068871f86fe7f0f48) in honor of U.S. servicemembers, veterans, and their families.


In addition to supporting


**Army mission readiness and modernization priorities** , Redwire has expanded its


**U.S. manufacturing footprint** and is also


**the largest supplier of UAS in the Baltics** , with a production facility in Riga, Latvia, that supports European allies, including combat operations in Ukraine.


**Learn why Redwire’s Stalker UAS is the combat-proven**[“workhorse warfighters keep asking for”](https://mcas-proxyweb.mcas-gov.us/certificate-checker?login=false&originalUrl=https%3A%2F%2Frdw.com.mcas-gov.us%2Fnewsroom%2F20-years-of-uas-evolution-how-stalker-became-the-workhorse-warfighters-keep-asking-for%2F%3FMcasTsid%3D20892&McasCSRF=be04e3610b11adfd74e3215aa91720994ccce749f992d4e068871f86fe7f0f48) **by visiting AUSA booth #2125.**
